data.title: Shams Townhouses
data.about:
Introducing Shams Townhouses at Nshama. 

Stunning 3 & 4 bedroom townhouses located within the most perfect family friendly community. Surrounded by greenery everywhere, these homes bring peace & tranquility to your life. Each home is crafted to perfection. 3 bedroom townhouses start at AED 1.7 million. Comfort meets convenience at Shams, with homes that are designed to elevate your living experience.

location_tile.title: Shams Townhouses is located near Town Square Dubai Park, where one can find various entertainment facilities and play areas.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Nearby are also retail and F&B outlets, as well as the 10km jogging and cycling track for your leisure options. Being situated away from the bustle, yet near the heart of the city, the Dubai Mall is 29 mins drive and Al Maktoum Airport is 25 mins away.

  • 20 mins – District 2020
  • 24 mins – Burj Al Arab
  • 25 mins – DWC Airport
  • 27 mins – Dubai Marina
  • 28 mins – Dubai INT Airport
  • 29 mins – Dubai Mall
